stories.title: Token Revocation API and Admin Controls
stories.description: Implement backend API endpoints and internal admin controls to revoke active tokens. Revocation must immediately invalidate the token, update status to revoked, and log audit metadata including actor and timestamp.

stories.title: Token Validation Middleware Integration
stories.description: Integrate token lifecycle checks (active, not expired, not revoked) into the GPTReader request handling path. Ensure all inbound requests enforce validation consistently using shared auth utilities.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering token creation, rotation, expiration, revocation, and invalid access attempts. Validate enforcement within GPTReader endpoints and ensure audit logging is triggered correctly.
